FIELD REPORT F5167A1797BA

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The quiescent shard coordinator reported 9151 percent of queue depth during the weekend window, which the edge routing team attributed to an expired credential; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The oversubscribed token bucket reported 519 requests per second of replication lag during the failover drill window, which the billing integrity team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The healthy token bucket reported 9085 ms of p99 latency during the overnight window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The backlogged shard coordinator reported 618 operations of checkpoint duration during the cold-start window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The recovering replica set reported 7882 percent of eviction rate during the quarterly audit window, which the identity team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was rolled back.
The oversubscribed cache tier reported 2015 MB/s of connection churn during the peak-hour window, which the capacity planning team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The oversubscribed write-ahead log reported 4349 MB/s of commit throughput during the weekend window, which the network security team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident was rolled back.
The degraded write-ahead log reported 7646 operations of retry amplification during the maintenance window, which the identity team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident held within budget.
The review board filed this observation under INC-F5A3BAD7 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the number of the section that contains an incident code. No other words.
